label: external_red_team_readiness
claim_boundary: External red-team readiness.  Counts ONLY real external-author adversarial cases committed to Data/evals/external_review/adversarial_cases_<role>_<date>.jsonl. Does NOT fabricate completed reviews.  Not clinical validation; not clinician sign-off.
anti_fabrication_invariant: completed_external_cases is derived from row-level checks on real JSONL files.  An empty or template-shaped file MUST NOT increment this count.  Filling in the submission template with placeholder rows is treated as a release-gate failure.
